videoDetails.title: Overtures Roundtable Discussion 2026 (Part 1)
videoDetails.shortDescription:
Join Derek Radney, Steve Tipton, David Coffin, and Howie Donahoe for a roundtable discussion exploring the overtures and the questions facing the PCA ahead of the 2026 General Assembly.

Overtures Discussion, Part 2: https://youtu.be/JpsstSfx40U
